integrityPolicy.ci: Node.js 24 clean install, application checks, syntax gates and Docker build
integrityPolicy.releaseManifest: Generate a fresh immutable per-file SHA-256 manifest only after connected free-staging acceptance passes.

note: The original 93-file Phase 2 SHA-256 manifest is intentionally not presented as current after the Render/Neon/R2/Upstash staging changes. This file prevents stale integrity metadata from being mistaken for the current source tree.
